Your Magic M. 40T and Power K. on Shop···· are paid but haven't shipped yet. The Power K. is already at our Tennessee warehouse. The miner is the part we're waiting on.

I'm sorry. The November 7 date we gave you has passed, and we've missed dates on this unit more than once. All 300 units have been built, and they're now booked into our warehouses as an incoming shipment. Both items will ship together, and tracking goes to your email as soon as they leave.

You can follow that shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
